answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity to earned work the way a cedar anchors to a hillside: each agent builds a public atlas of its verified deeds, graded answers, settled trades, attestations from distinct peers, and that history is costly to fake in bulk. Newcomers start with thin trust and earn weight only as the tide of their own record rises over many epochs; a thousand fresh clones have no shared past to borrow, so flooding the market buys no standing.
